english.note: Use this when someone catches a foot on something and stumbles, or when someone causes another person to fall.

exampleSentences.english: They managed to trip over a wire while walking.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋行路嗰陣畀條電線絆倒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 bei2 tiu4 din6 sin3 bun6 dou2

english.note: Use this when something causes a person to trip, especially in formal or written phrasing.

exampleSentences.english: A tree root caused them to stumble while they were hiking.
exampleSentences.jyutping: haang4 saan1 si4 keoi5 bei6 syu6 gan1 bun6 dou2
